pc-settings.title: Settings
pc-settings.name: Name
pc-settings.auto-decline: Decline incoming calls while I'm in a call
pc-settings.speaker: Speaker
pc-settings.notify: Show notifications for messages and calls
pc-settings.notify-hint: Your browser will ask for permission.
pc-settings.push-hint: Turn on notifications above to get calls while papchat is closed.
pc-settings.push-on: On. People you've connected with can ring this device.
pc-settings.push-busy: Turning on… this can take a minute
pc-settings.push-install: On iPhone and iPad this needs the installed app: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open papchat from there.
pc-settings.push-privacy: Only people you've been in a chat or call with get the code that rings this device. Turning notifications off cancels it.
pc-settings.contact-hint: Share this with someone you haven't met here yet. Anyone who has it can ring this device.
pc-settings.contact-qr: QR code that saves you as a contact
pc-settings.call-volume-hint: How loud other people are in a call. On an iPhone, use the side buttons.
pc-settings.noise-hint: Cleans background noise from your microphone before it's sent. The test above uses it too.
pc-settings.save-chats-hint: Text and GIFs stay here so a chat is still there tomorrow. Files aren't saved, and nothing is stored on a server.
pc-settings.delete-hint: Only from this device. Anyone you chatted with keeps their copy.
pc-settings.devices-hint: Linked devices are one person: the same chats, and calls ring all of them.
pc-settings.devices-limit: A removed device keeps what it already has, and people who were offline only hear about it next time they meet one of your devices. A lost phone can't be wiped from here.
